prompts.N01: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset, NOT a screenshot or concept poster. Generate one finished very wide 2:1 landscape 2D side-view environment background for a playable Chinese meme containment game. Theme N01: a contemporary shopping mall atrium children's pop-up event, cute but unnervingly over-repeated. Consistent sophisticated hand-drawn anime environment art, clean bold dark outlines, restrained painterly texture, soft cel shading, architecturally readable forms matching small anime white-coated research agents. Color palette cream yellow, ivory, warm orange, soft dusty pink; warm interior light with deep desaturated shadows, detailed but not cluttered. Straight-on side-scrolling elevation, no isometric camera, no deep central vanishing point. Compose a believable mall with glass upper railings, shopfronts, hanging wayfinding, an orange-yellow balloon arch, a small children's event podium behind the play path, gashapon vending machines and a merchandise stand. Right third centerpiece: a large cheerful cream-yellow round cartoon dragon-shaped PHOTO BOOTH display/sculpture, unmistakably a mall family event installation, not a living enemy. A recognizable photography frame, repeated blank rounded speech bubbles and duplicated cute sticker shapes contaminate the display screens. No readable text; leave small signage blank for in-engine Chinese typography. Left side is a clear arrivals opening and a portable capture device behind the play path. Center is spacious uncluttered foam-mat activity floor. Critical layout: a single continuous perfectly horizontal walkable baseline at 68.5 percent image height, across the entire width; no steps or gaps. Everything between x10–92 percent at y52–70 percent must be clear foreground air, not blocked by stalls or poles, so moving characters remain readable. Main architectural/event detail goes above y50 percent; small barriers/toys only at extreme left/right or BEHIND the path. Below baseline is the broad front edge of colorful padded floor and some foreground fence fragments only at extreme corners. Art should extend edge to edge, with complete environment, no border, no black margins. No people, no real enemies, no UI, no health bars, no cards, no labels or battle effects; exact enemy, actors, text, pollution animations are separate runtime layers. Distinguish arrival left, main capture zone center, event core right using flooring and set dressing without impeding the continuous walking line.
